purpose: Classify every memory object and LOAD/STORE in the trusted O0 typed reference IR for the exact canonical compiler source, correlating source-origin locations where possible. This is a semantic/sizing oracle only and cannot certify Stage1 natively.

memory_rules.load: exactly one index operand; index type tryte or i64; result type equals memory element type
memory_rules.store: exactly two operands ordered index,value; index type tryte or i64; value type equals memory element type
memory_rules.scalar_local: source-correlated mutable non-array declaration backed by length-1 memory; reference lowering uses explicit constant-zero index
memory_rules.local_array: source-correlated fixed array; memory length equals declared extent when element storage is represented by a memory object
memory_rules.array_parameter: source-correlated fixed array parameter; reference memory is immutable and initialized from incoming parameter cells
memory_rules.for_induction: length-1 mutable memory with explicit zero index
memory_rules.temporary: memory object with no declarative storage origin at the same function/source offset; never count it as a source local merely because its length is one

fail_closed: memory source-origin ambiguity is reported rather than guessed
non-tryte/non-i64 index is a reference invariant violation
source-correlated array extent mismatch is a reference invariant violation
source-correlated scalar storage with length other than one is a reference invariant violation
source-correlated scalar LOAD/STORE with known nonzero index is a reference invariant violation
STORE value type mismatch or LOAD result type mismatch is a reference invariant violation
